451 Anna {an'-nah}

源自希伯來文 SNH02584; 陰性專有名詞

欽定本 - Anna 1; 1

亞拿 = "恩典"
1) 耶路撒冷的女先知,屬亞設支派. 在聖殿見到嬰孩耶穌 (#路2:36|)
record.edic_text:
451 Anna {an'-nah}

of Hebrew origin 02584;; n pr f

AV - Anna 1; 1

Anna = "grace"
1) A prophetess in Jerusalem at the time of the Lord's presentation
   in the Temple. She was of the tribe of Asher.
